hanuka.translation: n. (犹太教的)献殿节,光明节

hanukah.translation:
n. 【节】光明节；修殿节；献殿节；烛光节
[网络] 点烛节；哈努卡节；点灯节

hanukkah.definition: n. (Judaism) an eight-day Jewish holiday commemorating the rededication of the Temple of Jerusalem in 165 BC
hanukkah.translation: n. 光明节（犹太教节日, 等于Chanukah）

hanuman.definition: n. in Hinduism, the monkey god and helper of Rama; god of devotion and courage
hanuman.translation: n. [动]长尾猴(产于南亚), (H-)[印神] 猴神
